basic_info.description: Gorgeous & Exceptional! Welcome to this well maintained 2-story single-family home in the highly sought-after Cayuga Terrace neighborhood. With 1,503 SQFT(per appraiser) of beautifully designed living space, this residence features 3BD/2BA in a quiet cul-de-sec. Behind its charming contemporary facade, you'll discover newly refinished hardwood flooring, fresh interior/exterior paint and a lot of natural light that fills the whole house. The main level boasts a sun-soaked living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, formal dining room, and kitchen equipped with appliances. The lower level features separate entrance, washer/dryer hookup installed in 1 car garage, and plenty of storage spaces. Step outside to enjoy a patio and a large lush garden with Loquat fruit trees, perfect for relaxation, barbecues, and family gatherings. Ideally situated near Genena Ave, Mission St, BART, Balboa Park, Muni, restaurants, shops, Safeway, CCSF & easy freeway access, this home truly has it all. A must see!
